title: Astrid and the Safehouse
premise: Elias Voss, a deniable asset for a diplomatic front called the Meridian Office, has spent nine years being no one—until a courier named Astrid delivers an envelope repaying a favor he never performed, along with coordinates to a safehouse and a debt marked 'with interest.' Inside the safehouse is Freya Joubert, the Office's legendary fixer, now burned, bleeding, and carrying proof that Elias's own agency orchestrated the massacre he was told never happened. To get her testimony to The Hague before dawn, Elias must run it past three governments' checkpoints and the assassin sent to close the account. He gets the truth onto the extraction flight—but only by staying behind as the decoy, trading his invisibility for a justice that may never know his name.
about_author: O. M. Quintana is the pen name of a former logistics consultant who spent a decade drafting contingency plans for organizations that preferred not to be named. Quintana writes thrillers about people whose jobs require them to be forgettable.

chapters.title: The Favor That Never Happened
chapters.summary: POV: Elias Voss. A quiet night in Lisbon shatters when a courier named Astrid returns an envelope for a favor Elias never did—containing cash, a key, and coordinates. His handlers deny everything; within hours his apartment is searched by someone professional. Emotional beat: the vertigo of a carefully invisible life cracking open, and the fatal curiosity that makes him use the key.

chapters.title: Freya in the Walls
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Elias and Freya Joubert. In the safehouse, Elias finds Freya wounded and hunted—the Office's best fixer, now its loose end. She reveals the ledger proving the Meridian Office manufactured the Atalaya massacre Elias was ordered to forget. Emotional beat: reluctant alliance forged in distrust, as loyalty to the institution curdles into the need for truth.

chapters.title: Three Borders Before Dawn
chapters.summary: POV: Elias. A night run through three governments' checkpoints with Freya's testimony on a drive, pursued by the assassin Callas, who knows Elias's real name—the one thing he thought was buried. A betrayal at the second border costs them their transport. Emotional beat: rising desperation and the dawning choice between saving himself and delivering the truth.

chapters.title: Extraction
chapters.summary: POV: Freya, closing on Elias's sacrifice. At the airfield, Freya boards the dawn flight carrying the testimony while Elias walks into the open as bait for Callas, buying the plane its window. Epilogue beat: months later, the tribunal convenes; Astrid delivers one last envelope to a man living quietly under a new name—the favor finally returned, with interest paid in full.
